+class HostParameters:
+    """Own CPU gold storage after target backward; never executes target math."""
+
+    def __init__(self, module):
+        self.parameters = {}
+        persistent, runtime = buffer_inventory(module)
+        self.persistent_buffers = {
+            name: value.detach().to('cpu', copy=True) for name, value in persistent.items()
+        }
+        self.runtime_buffers = {
+            name: value.detach().to('cpu', copy=True) for name, value in runtime.items()
+        }
+        for name, parameter in module.named_parameters():
+            value = nn.Parameter(
+                parameter.detach().to('cpu', copy=True), requires_grad=parameter.requires_grad
+            )
+            if parameter.requires_grad:
+                assert parameter.grad is not None, name
+                assert torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all(), name
+                value.grad = parameter.grad.detach().to('cpu', copy=True)
+            else:
+                assert parameter.grad is None, name
+            self.parameters[name] = value
+
+    def named_parameters(self):
+        return self.parameters.items()
+
+
+def buffer_inventory(module):
+    """Enumerate serialized buffers and nonpersistent runtime tensors separately."""
+    if isinstance(module, HostParameters):
+        return module.persistent_buffers, module.runtime_buffers
+    persistent, runtime = {}, {}
+    inactive = []
+    for prefix, child in module.named_modules():
+        for name, value in child._buffers.items():
+            full_name = f'{prefix}.{name}' if prefix else name
+            if value is None:
+                # PyTorch does not serialize None buffers; retain their names as
+                # inactive metadata, not silently as a numerical checkpoint key.
+                inactive.append(full_name)
+            elif name in child._non_persistent_buffers_set:
+                runtime[full_name] = value
+            else:
+                persistent[full_name] = value
+    record_details('inactive_registered_buffers', inactive)
+    return persistent, runtime
+
+
+class BufferContract:
+    """Exhaustive semantic-buffer map plus an explicit runtime-counter allowlist."""
+
+    def __init__(self, actual, native, links=(), runtime_names=()):
+        self.links = tuple(links)
+        self.runtime_names = set(runtime_names)
+        actual_persistent, actual_runtime = buffer_inventory(actual)
+        native_persistent, native_runtime = buffer_inventory(native)
+        assert set(actual_persistent) == {left for left, _ in self.links}
+        assert set(native_persistent) == {right for _, right in self.links}
+        assert set(actual_runtime) == self.runtime_names, sorted(actual_runtime)
+        assert not native_runtime, sorted(native_runtime)
+        self.values = {}
+        self.runtime_before = {}
+        for left, right in self.links:
+            a, n = actual_persistent[left], native_persistent[right]
+            assert a.shape == n.shape == (EXPERTS,), (left, right)
+            assert a.dtype == n.dtype == torch.float32, (left, right)
+            assert not a.requires_grad and not n.requires_grad
+            n.copy_(a)
+            self.values[left] = a.detach().to('cpu', copy=True)
+        for name, value in actual_runtime.items():
+            assert name.endswith('.router.local_tokens_per_expert'), name
+            assert value.shape == (EXPERTS,) and not value.requires_grad, name
+            self.runtime_before[name] = value.detach().to('cpu', copy=True)
+        record_details(
+            'buffer_inventory',
+            {
+                'persistent_map': [list(link) for link in self.links],
+                'runtime_allowlist': sorted(self.runtime_names),
+                'note': 'quantile/global-aux/hash buffers are forbidden by this declared profile',
+            },
+        )
+
+    def assert_actual_unchanged(self, actual, router_records=()):
+        persistent, runtime = buffer_inventory(actual)
+        assert set(persistent) == set(self.values)
+        assert set(runtime) == self.runtime_names
+        for name, before in self.values.items():
+            assert persistent[name].dtype == torch.float32, name
+            torch.testing.assert_close(persistent[name].detach().cpu(), before, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        if self.runtime_names:
+            assert len(router_records) == 1
+            counts = router_records[0][1].sum(0)
+            for name, value in runtime.items():
+                delta = value.detach().cpu() - self.runtime_before[name]
+                torch.testing.assert_close(delta.double(), counts.double(), rtol=0, atol=0)
+            record_details(
+                'runtime_counter_values',
+                {
+                    name: {'dtype': str(value.dtype), 'counts': value.detach().cpu().tolist()}
+                    for name, value in runtime.items()
+                },
+            )
+        record_details('persistent_buffers_unchanged', True)
+
+    def copy_native(self, actual, native):
+        actual_persistent, actual_runtime = buffer_inventory(actual)
+        native_persistent, native_runtime = buffer_inventory(native)
+        assert set(actual_persistent) == set(self.values)
+        assert set(actual_runtime) == self.runtime_names and not native_runtime
+        assert set(native_persistent) == {right for _, right in self.links}
+        for left, right in self.links:
+            assert actual_persistent[left].dtype == native_persistent[right].dtype == torch.float32
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                actual_persistent[left].cpu(), self.values[left], rtol=0, atol=0
+            )
+            native_persistent[right].copy_(actual_persistent[left])
+
+    def assert_native_unchanged(self, native):
+        persistent, runtime = buffer_inventory(native)
+        assert not runtime and set(persistent) == {right for _, right in self.links}
+        for left, right in self.links:
+            assert persistent[right].dtype == torch.float32
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                persistent[right].detach().cpu(), self.values[left], rtol=0, atol=0
+            )
+

+class NativeEmbedding(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, device):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(VOCAB, HIDDEN, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+
+    def forward(self, tokens):

+def successor_tokens(tokens):
+    """CP1 training successor: copy, zero-fill the end, never circularly wrap."""
+    successor = torch.zeros_like(tokens)
+    successor[:, :-1] = tokens[:, 1:]
+    return successor

+class NativeMTP(nn.Module):
+    """Source-backed single-stream contract, NOT complete official-HF MTP parity.
+
+    Structure: vllm-project/vllm@10d2c6083d3b7508f2409a127a1d03dd489e427c,
+    vllm/models/glm5next/common/mtp.py51-115 (blob2bb8b10d074676fad5ee06da087913302b031649),
+    common/model.py368-442,532-549 and nvidia/ops/fused_eh_norm.py39-49.
+    Those independently confirm embedding-first, DE, no inner mHC and one final
+    norm. Component arithmetic deliberately follows HF93c8, including its
+    cast-before-weight RMSNorm, NOT vLLM's fused EH rounding or speculative
+    position-zero handling. The successor training definition is above.
+    attention_contract selects only the attention core (NativeAttention).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, device, *, attention_contract='hf_eager'):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.enorm = NativeRMSNorm(HIDDEN, device)
+        self.hnorm = NativeRMSNorm(HIDDEN, device)
+        self.eh_proj = NativeLinear(2 * HIDDEN, HIDDEN, device)
+        self.input_layernorm = NativeRMSNorm(HIDDEN, device)
+        self.self_attn = NativeAttention(device, core_contract=attention_contract)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = NativeRMSNorm(HIDDEN, device)
+        self.mlp = NativeMoE(device)
+        self.final_norm = NativeRMSNorm(HIDDEN, device)
+
+    def attention_stage(self, hidden, embedding):
+        hidden = self.eh_proj(torch.cat((self.enorm(embedding), self.hnorm(hidden)), -1))
+        return hidden + self.self_attn(self.input_layernorm(hidden))
+
+    def ffn_input(self, hidden, embedding):
+        return self.post_attention_layernorm(self.attention_stage(hidden, embedding))
+
+    def forward(self, hidden, embedding):
+        hidden = self.attention_stage(hidden, embedding)
+        hidden = hidden + self.mlp(self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden))
+        return self.final_norm(hidden)
+
+
+class NativeMTPHarness(nn.Module):
+    """Independent shared embedding/head and one MTP depth, no base decoder."""
+
+    def __init__(self, device, *, attention_contract='hf_eager'):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embedding = NativeEmbedding(device)
+        self.output_layer = NativeLinear(HIDDEN, VOCAB, device)
+        self.mtp = NativeMTP(device, attention_contract=attention_contract)
+
+    def ffn_input(self, hidden, tokens):
+        return self.mtp.ffn_input(hidden, self.embedding(successor_tokens(tokens)))
+
+    def forward(self, hidden, tokens):
+        predicted = self.mtp(hidden, self.embedding(successor_tokens(tokens)))
+        return (
+            torch.cat((hidden, predicted), 0),
+            self.output_layer(hidden),
+            self.output_layer(predicted),
+        )
+
+
+class NativeCompositeModel(NativeMTPHarness):
+    """One real-width early KDA+dense block followed by single-depth DE MTP.
+
+    attention_contract reaches only the MTP attention; the decoder block is KDA.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, device, *, wire=False, attention_contract='hf_eager'):
+        super().__init__(device, attention_contract=attention_contract)
+        self.decoder = NativeHybridBlock(device, expand=not wire)
+
+    def ffn_input(self, tokens, wire=None):
+        hidden = self.decoder(self.embedding(tokens) if wire is None else wire)
+        return self.mtp.ffn_input(hidden, self.embedding(successor_tokens(tokens)))
+
+    def forward(self, tokens, wire=None):
+        self.decoder_input = self.embedding(tokens) if wire is None else wire
+        self.decoder_input.retain_grad()
+        hidden = self.decoder(self.decoder_input)
+        return super().forward(hidden, tokens)

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ParameterLink:
+    """An explicit contiguous slice on either side of a packed parameter map."""
+
+    native: str
+    actual: str
+    native_slice: slice | None = None
+    actual_slice: slice | None = None

+def linked_view(tensor, selection):
+    return tensor if selection is None else tensor[selection]

+def assert_complete_mapping(actual, native, links):
+    """Prove whole-parameter coverage without a billion-element coverage mask."""
+    actual_parameters, native_parameters = dict(actual.named_parameters()), dict(
+        native.named_parameters()
+    )
+    assert set(actual_parameters) == {link.actual for link in links}
+    assert set(native_parameters) == {link.native for link in links}
+    record_details(
+        'parameter_inventory',
+        {
+            'actual_named': len(actual_parameters),
+            'native_named': len(native_parameters),
+            'mapped_slices': len(links),
+            'actual_parameter_elements': sum(
+                parameter.numel() for parameter in actual_parameters.values()
+            ),
+            'frozen_actual_names': [
+                name for name, parameter in actual_parameters.items() if not parameter.requires_grad
+            ],
+        },
+    )
+    for parameters, name_key, slice_key in (
+        (actual_parameters, 'actual', 'actual_slice'),
+        (native_parameters, 'native', 'native_slice'),
+    ):
+        for name, parameter in parameters.items():
+            intervals = []
+            for link in links:
+                if getattr(link, name_key) == name:
+                    view = linked_view(parameter, getattr(link, slice_key))
+                    assert view.is_contiguous(), name
+                    start = view.storage_offset() - parameter.storage_offset()
+                    intervals.append((start, start + view.numel()))
+            cursor = 0
+            for start, end in sorted(intervals):
+                assert start == cursor and end > start, (name, intervals)
+                cursor = end
+            assert cursor == parameter.numel(), (name, intervals)
+    for link in links:
+        a = linked_view(actual_parameters[link.actual], link.actual_slice)
+        n = linked_view(native_parameters[link.native], link.native_slice)
+        assert a.shape == n.shape, link
+        assert a.dtype == n.dtype, link
+        assert (
+            actual_parameters[link.actual].requires_grad
+            == native_parameters[link.native].requires_grad
+        ), link
+    return actual_parameters, native_parameters
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def copy_parameters(actual, native, links):
+    actual_parameters, native_parameters = assert_complete_mapping(actual, native, links)
+    for link in links:
+        linked_view(native_parameters[link.native], link.native_slice).copy_(
+            linked_view(actual_parameters[link.actual], link.actual_slice)
+        )

+def assert_similarity(actual, expected, label, *, exact_zero=False):
+    """Bound temporary storage; both skill metrics are required above0.999."""
+    assert actual is not None and expected is not None, label
+    assert actual.shape == expected.shape and actual.numel() > 0, label
+    assert actual.dtype == expected.dtype, label
+    a, b = actual.detach().reshape(-1), expected.detach().reshape(-1)
+    dot = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float64, device=expected.device)
+    norm_a, norm_b = dot.clone(), dot.clone()
+    for start in range(0, a.numel(), 262144):
+        x = a[start : start + 262144].to(device=b.device, dtype=torch.float64)
+        y = b[start : start + 262144].double()
+        assert torch.isfinite(x).all() and torch.isfinite(y).all(), label
+        dot += (x * y).sum()
+        norm_a += x.square().sum()
+        norm_b += y.square().sum()
+    if exact_zero:
+        assert norm_a.item() == norm_b.item() == 0.0, label
+        ledger = _LEDGER.get()
+        if ledger is not None:
+            ledger.zero_operands += 2
+        return
+    assert norm_a.item() > 0 and norm_b.item() > 0, f'{label}: unexpected all-zero operand'
+    cosine = (dot / (norm_a * norm_b).sqrt()).item()
+    similarity = (2 * dot / (norm_a + norm_b)).item()
+    ledger = _LEDGER.get()
+    if ledger is not None:
+        ledger.finite_operands += 2
+        ledger.comparisons.append(
+            {
+                'name': label,
+                'cosine': cosine,
+                'tensor_similarity': similarity,
+                'shape': list(actual.shape),
+                'dtype': str(actual.dtype),
+            }
+        )
+    assert cosine > 0.999, f'{label}: cosine={cosine}'
+    assert similarity > 0.999, f'{label}: tensor_similarity={similarity}'
+

+def assert_all_gradients(actual, native, links, *, decomposed=None):
+    """Compare every linked gradient at the 0.999 bars.
+
+    decomposed, when given, must be exactly the set of mHC scale links in this
+    inventory, each verified by assert_mhc_decomposition; those shape-[1] links
+    are then accounted for by their contribution tensors, never silently.

+    actual_parameters, native_parameters = assert_complete_mapping(actual, native, links)
+    if decomposed is not None:
+        scales = {link.actual for link in links if is_mhc_scale(link.actual)}
+        assert set(decomposed) == scales, (sorted(decomposed), sorted(scales))
+    decomposed = decomposed or {}

+        if not a.requires_grad:
+            assert a.grad is n.grad is None, link
+        else:

+            if link.actual in decomposed:

+                index = [name for name, _ in MHC_GROUPS].index(group)
+                assert link.native_slice == slice(index, index + 1), link
+                continue
+            assert_similarity(

+def _relative_difference(target, reference):
+    target, reference = target.double(), reference.double()
+    return ((target - reference).norm() / reference.norm().clamp_min(1e-300)).item()

+def _row_rms(values, kept):
+    """RMS over each row's kept elements; values, kept: [rows, columns]."""
+    squares = torch.where(kept, values.square(), torch.zeros_like(values))
+    return (squares.sum(-1) / kept.sum(-1).clamp_min(1)).sqrt()

+class ClampReplay:
+    """Replay target SwiGLU clamp decisions inside reference FFNs.
+
+    Bind each reference FFN to the target's observed pre-activation FC1 output
+    of the same site. The decision (clamp_decisions: gate upper, up upper, up
+    lower) is computed from the target values; the reference keeps its own
+    values, so where(decision, +-10, value) is bitwise clamp() in value and
+    gradient when both sides agree, on either torch boundary rule.
+
+    A decision that differs from the reference's own must be a near tie:
+    |v_target - v_ref| <= max(CLAMP_TIE_FLOOR, CLAMP_TIE_SIGMAS * d_i *
+    ||W_j||) for row i and output column j, where W_j is the reference's FC1
+    weight row of that column. The fixture draws the weight rows independently
+    of the FFN input, so a row input difference dx_i gives every column a
+    difference dx_i . W_j of RMS ||dx_i|| * ||W_j|| / sqrt(H): the std-0.5
+    coverage columns, the only ones that reach the threshold, are 25 times
+    wider than the rest. d_i measures ||dx_i|| / sqrt(H) as the RMS of
+    (v_target - v_ref) / ||W_k|| over row i's gate and up elements, without
+    the moved ones, so a gross element cannot widen its own band. It is per
+    row because the input difference varies by token. Every bound site must
+    run exactly once. Records reach the ledger before any assertion.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.sites, self.records = {}, []
+
+    def bind(self, label, module, target):
+        """Dense or shared-expert FFN; target is its [..., 2W] FC1 output."""
+        gate, up = target.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        self._attach(label, module, lambda rows: (gate, up), rows_expected=False)
+
+    def bind_routed(self, label, moe, target, routing, tokens_per_expert, permuted_probs, probs):
+        """Routed experts; target rows are expert-major with ascending tokens.
+
+        routing/probs are the target router's [tokens, experts] outputs. The
+        rebuilt order must reproduce the target's per-expert counts and its
+        permuted probabilities bitwise, so a misaligned replay cannot pass.
+        """
+        routing, probs = routing.cpu(), probs.cpu()
+        experts = routing.size(1)
+        assert len(moe.experts) == experts, label
+        counts = routing.sum(0)
+        assert counts.tolist() == [int(value) for value in tokens_per_expert], label
+        mask = routing.T.contiguous()
+        tokens = torch.arange(routing.size(0)).expand(experts, -1).masked_select(mask)
+        expected_probs = probs.T.contiguous().masked_select(mask)
+        assert torch.equal(permuted_probs.cpu(), expected_probs), f'{label}: permuted order'
+        assert target.size(0) == tokens.numel(), label
+        starts = [0] + torch.cumsum(counts, 0).tolist()
+        for expert, module in enumerate(moe.experts):
+            span = slice(starts[expert], starts[expert + 1])
+            order, values = tokens[span], target[span]
+
+            def select(rows, order=order, values=values, expert=expert):
+                rows = rows.cpu()
+                assert rows.numel() == order.numel(), (label, expert)
+                index = torch.searchsorted(order, rows)
+                assert torch.equal(order[index.clamp(max=order.numel() - 1)], rows), (label, expert)
+                return values[index.to(values.device)].chunk(2, dim=-1)
+
+            self._attach(f'{label}.{expert}', module, select, rows_expected=True)
+
+    def _attach(self, label, module, select, *, rows_expected):
+        assert label not in self.sites and getattr(module, 'clamp_replay', None) is None, label
+        self.sites[label] = 0
+
+        def replay(gate, up, rows):
+            assert (rows is not None) is rows_expected, label
+            self.sites[label] += 1
+            target_gate, target_up = (value.to(device=gate.device) for value in select(rows))
+            return self._apply(label, gate, up, target_gate, target_up, module, rows)
+
+        module.clamp_replay = replay
+
+    def _apply(self, label, gate, up, target_gate, target_up, module, rows=None):
+        assert target_gate.shape == gate.shape and target_up.shape == up.shape, label
+        assert target_gate.dtype == gate.dtype and target_up.dtype == up.dtype, label
+        decided = clamp_decisions(target_gate, target_up)
+        own = clamp_decisions(gate.detach(), up.detach())
+        moved = {'gate': own[0] ^ decided[0], 'up': (own[1] ^ decided[1]) | (own[2] ^ decided[2])}
+        record = {'site': label, 'elements': gate.numel(), 'flips': {}}
+        self.records.append(record)
+        width, rowwise = gate.size(-1), None
+        for name, half, target, value, mine, theirs in (
+            ('gate_upper', 'gate', target_gate, gate, own[0], decided[0]),
+            ('up_upper', 'up', target_up, up, own[1], decided[1]),
+            ('up_lower', 'up', target_up, up, own[2], decided[2]),
+        ):
+            flipped = mine ^ theirs
+            count = int(flipped.sum())
+            record['flips'][name] = count
+            if count:
+                if rowwise is None:
+                    rowwise = self._row_scales(gate, up, target_gate, target_up, moved, module)
+                scale, relative_rows, norms, normalized, kept = rowwise
+                offset = 0 if half == 'gate' else width
+                band = CLAMP_TIE_SIGMAS * scale[:, None] * norms[offset : offset + width]
+                band = band.clamp_min(CLAMP_TIE_FLOOR)
+                flipped = flipped.reshape(-1, width)
+                spread = (target.double() - value.detach().double()).reshape(-1, width).abs()
+                fraction = (spread / band)[flipped]
+                worst = int(fraction.argmax())
+                row, column = flipped.nonzero()[worst].tolist()
+                # Recorded, not asserted: the row's relative input difference against the
+                # call's median (token heterogeneity); the worst column's RMS difference in
+                # units of its rows' d_i (about 1 unless the column has an excess the weight
+                # geometry misses); the A1 call-level r of earlier receipts.
+                index = offset + column
+                column_kept = kept[:, index]
+                excess = normalized[column_kept, index] / scale[column_kept].clamp_min(1e-300)
+                record.setdefault('ties', {})[name] = {
+                    'max_fraction_of_band': fraction[worst].item(),
+                    'abs_difference_at_max': spread[row, column].item(),
+                    'band_at_max': band[row, column].item(),
+                    'row_at_max': row if rows is None else int(rows[row]),
+                    'column_at_max': column,
+                    'row_scale_at_max': scale[row].item(),
+                    'row_relative_at_max': relative_rows[row].item(),
+                    'row_relative_median': relative_rows.median().item(),
+                    'column_excess_at_max': excess.square().mean().sqrt().item(),
+                    'relative_difference': _relative_difference(
+                        target[~moved[half]], value.detach()[~moved[half]]
+                    ),
+                }
+                if fraction[worst] > 1:
+                    record_details('clamp_replay', self.summary())
+                    raise AssertionError(
+                        f'{label}: {name} decision is not a near tie {record["ties"][name]}'
+                    )
+        gate = torch.where(decided[0], CLAMP, gate)
+        up = torch.where(decided[1], CLAMP, torch.where(decided[2], -CLAMP, up))
+        return gate, up
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _row_scales(gate, up, target_gate, target_up, moved, module):
+        """Row scales d_i (class docstring) and what the records derive from them.
+
+        Returns d [rows]; the rows' relative input differences d_i / c_i [rows],
+        where c_i, the RMS of v_ref / ||W_k|| over the row, estimates
+        ||x_i|| / sqrt(H); the FC1 weight row norms [2W]; (v_target - v_ref) /
+        ||W|| [rows, 2W]; and the kept mask [rows, 2W]. Gate columns come first,
+        the order of the concatenated gate/up weight.
+        """
+        width = gate.size(-1)
+        norms = torch.cat(
+            [
+                torch.linalg.vector_norm(weight.detach(), dim=-1, dtype=torch.float64)
+                for weight in (module.gate_proj.weight, module.up_proj.weight)
+            ]
+        ).to(gate.device)
+        assert norms.shape == (2 * width,), norms.shape
+
+        def as_rows(value):
+            return value.detach().double().reshape(-1, width)
+
+        reference = torch.cat((as_rows(gate), as_rows(up)), -1)
+        normalized = (torch.cat((as_rows(target_gate), as_rows(target_up)), -1) - reference) / norms
+        kept = ~torch.cat((moved['gate'].reshape(-1, width), moved['up'].reshape(-1, width)), -1)
+        scale = _row_rms(normalized, kept)
+        typical = _row_rms(reference / norms, torch.ones_like(kept))
+        return scale, scale / typical.clamp_min(1e-300), norms, normalized, kept
+
+    def summary(self):
+        totals = {}
+        for record in self.records:
+            for name, count in record['flips'].items():
+                totals[name] = totals.get(name, 0) + count
+        return {
+            'sites': len(self.sites),
+            'calls': len(self.records),
+            'flip_totals': totals,
+            'tie_records': [record for record in self.records if 'ties' in record],
+        }
+
+    def assert_consumed(self):
+        summary = self.summary()
+        record_details('clamp_replay', summary)
+        assert self.sites and all(count == 1 for count in self.sites.values()), {
+            label: count for label, count in self.sites.items() if count != 1
+        }
+        return summary['flip_totals']
+
+
+def mhc_contributions(gradient, projection, scales):
+    """Per-group addends of the three scale gradients, in float64.
+
+    gradient is dL/dproj (or dL/dmix), whose columns carry their group's scale
+    factor; scales are the three scale values (pre, post, res).
+    """
+    gradient, projection = gradient.detach().double(), projection.detach().double()
+    return {
+        group: gradient[..., columns] / float(scales[index]) * projection[..., columns]
+        for index, (group, columns) in enumerate(MHC_GROUPS)
+    }
+
+
+def assert_mhc_decomposition(actual, native, captures, sites):
+    """Replace each shape-[1] mHC scale link with its contribution tensor.
+
+    captures maps an actual mHC prefix to the target's _compute_h input
+    {'proj', 'grad'}; sites lists (actual prefix, native NativeMHC name).
+    Per group: the contribution tensors meet the 0.999 bars, and each side's
+    scale gradient equals the sum of its contributions within
+    MHC_RECONSTRUCTION_RTOL of their absolute sum. Returns
+    {actual scale name: native scale name} for assert_all_gradients.
+    """
+    actual_parameters = dict(actual.named_parameters())
+    verified, report = {}, []
+    try:
+        for prefix, native_name in sites:
+            verified.update(
+                _decompose_site(actual_parameters, native, captures, prefix, native_name, report)
+            )
+    finally:
+        # Recorded even when a group fails, for the diagnosis.
+        record_details('mhc_scale_decomposition', report)
+    return verified
+
+
+def _decompose_site(actual_parameters, native, captures, prefix, native_name, report):
+    mhc = native.get_submodule(native_name)
+    mix = mhc.last_mix
+    assert mix.grad is not None, native_name
+    target = captures[prefix]
+    assert target['grad'] is not None, prefix
+    alphas = [actual_parameters[f'{prefix}.alpha_{group}'] for group, _ in MHC_GROUPS]
+    actual_parts = mhc_contributions(
+        target['grad'], target['proj'], [float(alpha.detach()) for alpha in alphas]
+    )
+    native_parts = mhc_contributions(mix.grad, mix, mhc.scale.detach().tolist())
+    verified = {}
+    for index, (group, _) in enumerate(MHC_GROUPS):
+        a = actual_parts[group]
+        n = native_parts[group].to(a.device)
+        sums = {}
+        for side, parts, scalar in (
+            ('actual', a, alphas[index].grad.detach().double().reshape(())),
+            ('native', n, mhc.scale.grad.detach().double()[index].to(a.device)),
+        ):
+            sums[side] = (
+                scalar.item(),
+                parts.abs().sum().item(),
+                (scalar - parts.sum()).abs().item(),
+            )
+        value_a, value_n = sums['actual'][0], sums['native'][0]
+        report.append(
+            {
+                'link': f'{prefix}.alpha_{group}',
+                'actual_scale_gradient': value_a,
+                'native_scale_gradient': value_n,
+                'scalar_similarity': 2 * value_a * value_n / (value_a**2 + value_n**2),
+                'native_cancellation': sums['native'][1] / max(abs(value_n), 1e-300),
+                'difference_over_abs_sum': abs(value_a - value_n) / sums['native'][1],
+                'reconstruction_residuals': [sums['actual'][2], sums['native'][2]],
+            }
+        )
+        for side, (scalar, scale, residual) in sums.items():
+            assert residual <= MHC_RECONSTRUCTION_RTOL * scale, (
+                f'{prefix}.alpha_{group} {side}: scale gradient {scalar} is not the sum '
+                f'of its contributions (residual {residual}, abs sum {scale})'
+            )
+        assert_similarity(a, n, f'{prefix}.alpha_{group} contributions <- {native_name}')
+        verified[f'{prefix}.alpha_{group}'] = f'{native_name}.scale'
+    return verified

+"""Opt-in mutation controls for the composite mHC comparison criteria.
+
+Each case mutates one side of a composite test and must be detected by a
+named criterion check: the comparison raises AssertionError whose message
+carries one of the case's accepted fragments. An unmutated control must pass.
+Run with GLM53_COMPOSITE_DIAG=1; this is a diagnostic of the criteria, not a
+CI test.

+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.unit_tests.models.test_glm53_hybrid_native_parity import (  # noqa: F401
+    _model_parallel,
+    _run_dsa_moe,
+    _run_kda_dense,
+)
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.internal,
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        os.environ.get('GLM53_COMPOSITE_DIAG') != '1', reason='set GLM53_COMPOSITE_DIAG=1'
+    ),
+]
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def zero_ffn_pre_bias(native):
+    native.ffn_hc.base[0:4].zero_()
+
+
+def swap_attention_post_streams(native):
+    mappings = native.attn_hc.mappings
+
+    def swapped(hidden):
+        aggregated, post, comb = mappings(hidden)
+        order = torch.tensor([1, 0, 2, 3], device=post.device)
+        return aggregated, post.index_select(-1, order), comb
+
+    native.attn_hc.mappings = swapped
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def scale_target_ffn_pre_gradient(real):
+    real.layers[1].hyper_connection.alpha_pre.grad.mul_(1.5)
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def double_native_ffn_pre_addends(native):
+    # Consistent on the reference side: its scale gradient stays the sum of its
+    # contributions, so only the contribution tensor comparison can see it.
+    native.ffn_hc.last_mix.grad[..., 0:4].mul_(2)
+    native.ffn_hc.scale.grad[0:1].mul_(2)
+
+
+def lower_target_clamp(config):
+    config.activation_func_clamp_value = 9.5
+
+
+def kda(monkeypatch, mutate):
+    _run_kda_dense(False, False, monkeypatch, compare_all_parameters=True, mutate=mutate)
+
+
+def dsa(monkeypatch, mutate):
+    _run_dsa_moe('none', monkeypatch, mutate=mutate)
+
+
+PARITY = ('cosine=', 'tensor_similarity=')
+RECONSTRUCTION = ('is not the sum of its contributions',)
+NEAR_TIE = ('decision is not a near tie',)
+
+# case: (runner, hook point -> mutation, accepted message fragments)
+CASES = {
+    'M1_ffn_pre_bias_zeroed': (kda, {'native': zero_ffn_pre_bias}, PARITY + NEAR_TIE),
+    'M2_attention_post_streams_swapped': (
+        kda,
+        {'native': swap_attention_post_streams},
+        PARITY + NEAR_TIE,
+    ),
+    'Ms_target_ffn_pre_scale_gradient_x1p5': (
+        kda,
+        {'actual_gradients': scale_target_ffn_pre_gradient},
+        RECONSTRUCTION,
+    ),
+    'Mg_reference_ffn_pre_addends_x2': (
+        kda,
+        {'native_gradients': double_native_ffn_pre_addends},
+        ('layers.1.hyper_connection.alpha_pre contributions',),
+    ),
+    # The target clamps (9.5, 10] while decisions are replayed at 10, so only
+    # the parity bars can see it; a near-tie trip would not count.
+    'Mc_target_clamp_threshold_9p5': (dsa, {'config': lower_target_clamp}, PARITY),
+}
+
+
+def test_glm53_composite_criteria_unmutated_control(monkeypatch):
+    """The KDA runner passes without a mutation (the DSA control is the parity test itself)."""
+    kda(monkeypatch, None)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('case', sorted(CASES))
+def test_glm53_composite_criteria_detect_mutation(case, monkeypatch):
+    runner, mutate, fragments = CASES[case]
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError) as error:
+        runner(monkeypatch, mutate)
+    message = str(error.value)
+    print(f'GLM53_COMPOSITE_DIAG {case} detected: {message.splitlines()[0][:300]}')
+    assert any(fragment in message for fragment in fragments), message[:300]

+def _record_moe_probability_placement(module):
+    """Record real expert calls without retaining tensors or changing their graph."""
+    config = next(child.config for child in module.modules() if hasattr(child, 'config'))
+    requested = config.moe_apply_probs_after_fc2
+    assert type(requested) is bool
+    experts = [
+        (name, child) for name, child in module.named_modules() if type(child) is TEGroupedMLP
+    ]
+    assert bool(experts) is requested
+    for _, child in experts:
+        assert child.config.moe_apply_probs_after_fc2 is True
+        assert child._with_fused_impl is False and child._use_grouped_tensor is False
+    profile = {
+        'requested': requested,
+        'applicable': bool(experts),
+        'module_count': len(experts),
+        'module_names': [name for name, _ in experts],
+        'forward_calls': [],
+        'not_applicable_reason': None if experts else 'no routed experts in this case',
+    }
+    # record_details stores this same dictionary; actual hooks append before publish.
+    record_details('moe_probability_placement', profile)
+
+    def observe(child, inputs, kwargs, output, *, module_name):
+        hidden = inputs[0] if inputs else kwargs['permuted_local_hidden_states']
+        probs = inputs[2] if len(inputs) > 2 else kwargs['permuted_probs']
+        assert type(child) is TEGroupedMLP
+        assert child.config.moe_apply_probs_after_fc2 is True
+        assert child._with_fused_impl is False and child._use_grouped_tensor is False
+        assert isinstance(hidden, torch.Tensor) and isinstance(probs, torch.Tensor)
+        assert hidden.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and probs.dtype == torch.float32
+        assert hidden.ndim == 2 and hidden.shape[1] == HIDDEN
+        assert probs.ndim == 1 and probs.shape[0] == hidden.shape[0]
+        assert isinstance(output, tuple) and len(output) == 2
+        result, bias = output
+        assert isinstance(result, torch.Tensor) and bias is None
+        assert result.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and result.shape == hidden.shape
+        assert hidden.device == probs.device == result.device
+        profile['forward_calls'].append(
+            {
+                'module_name': module_name,
+                'requested': child.config.moe_apply_probs_after_fc2,
+                'input_dtype': str(hidden.dtype),
+                'prob_dtype': str(probs.dtype),
+                'output_dtype': str(result.dtype),
+                'input_shape': list(hidden.shape),
+                'prob_shape': list(probs.shape),
+                'output_shape': list(result.shape),
+                'fused_impl': child._with_fused_impl,
+                'grouped_tensor': child._use_grouped_tensor,
+                'bias_is_none': bias is None,
+            }
+        )
+        # None preserves the original output object and all original autograd edges.
+
+    for name, child in experts:
+
+        def hook(child, inputs, kwargs, output, module_name=name):
+            return observe(child, inputs, kwargs, output, module_name=module_name)
+
+        child.register_forward_hook(hook, with_kwargs=True)

+def _hf_recurrent_core(query, key, value, g, beta):
+    """HF source order, FP32 result before its final activation-dtype restoration."""
+    query, key, value, g, beta = [x.to(torch.float32) for x in (query, key, value, g, beta)]
+    query = query / torch.sqrt((query * query).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+    key = key / torch.sqrt((key * key).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+    query = query * (query.shape[-1] ** -0.5)
+    batch, sequence, heads, width = key.shape
+    state = torch.zeros(
+        batch, heads, width, value.shape[-1], device=value.device, dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    outputs = []
+    for token in range(sequence):
+        q_i, k_i, v_i = query[:, token], key[:, token], value[:, token]
+        g_i, beta_i = g[:, token][..., None].exp(), beta[:, token][..., None]
+        state = state * g_i
+        memory = (state * k_i[..., None]).sum(-2)
+        delta = (v_i - memory) * beta_i
+        state = state + k_i.unsqueeze(-1) * delta.unsqueeze(-2)
+        outputs.append((state * q_i.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(-2))
+    return torch.stack(outputs, dim=1)

+    assert torch.count_nonzero(a) and torch.count_nonzero(b), name
+    cosine = F.cosine_similarity(a[None], b[None]).item()
+    similarity = (2 * (a * b).sum() / ((a * a + b * b).sum())).item()
+    assert cosine > 0.999, f'{name}: cosine={cosine}'
+    assert similarity > 0.999, f'{name}: tensor_similarity={similarity}'
+    return dict(name=name, cosine=cosine, tensor_similarity=similarity)

+``recurrent_kimi_delta_attention``. The reference intentionally uses only

+The pinned model's ``_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`` keeps ``conv1d`` FP32.

+# reduction-sensitive gate/beta gradients. For equal-norm tensors that floor
+# is about 2e-4 in tensor similarity, so 1e-3 leaves BF16 GEMM/convolution

+_SIMILARITY_CHUNK_SIZE = 4 * 1024 * 1024

+class _NativeForgetGate(nn.Module):
+    """PyTorch transcription of ``Glm5NextTextForgetGate``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.f_a_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN_SIZE, _LORA_RANK, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.f_b_proj = nn.Linear(_LORA_RANK, _QKV_DIM, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.dt_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(_QKV_DIM, device=device, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.A_log = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(_NUM_HEADS, device=device, dtype=torch.float32))
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raw_gate = F.linear(F.linear(hidden_states, self.f_a_proj.weight), self.f_b_proj.weight)
+        gate = (raw_gate.float() + self.dt_bias.float().view(1, 1, -1)).view(
+            hidden_states.shape[0], hidden_states.shape[1], _NUM_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM
+        )
+        decay_rate = self.A_log.float().view(1, 1, _NUM_HEADS, 1).exp()
+        return _LOWER_BOUND * torch.sigmoid(decay_rate * gate)
+
+
+class _NativeRMSNormGated(nn.Module):
+    """Strict-FP32 RMSNorm and sigmoid gate with one final dtype cast."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(_HEAD_DIM, device=device, dtype=dtype))
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        input_dtype = hidden_states.dtype
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.float()
+        variance = hidden_states.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        hidden_states = hidden_states * torch.rsqrt(variance + _NORM_EPS)
+        hidden_states = hidden_states * self.weight.float()
+        hidden_states = hidden_states * torch.sigmoid(gate.float())
+        return hidden_states.to(input_dtype)
+

+class _NativeGlm5NextKDA(nn.Module):
+    """Official GLM-5.3-Flash KDA expressed with native PyTorch operations."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN_SIZE, _QKV_DIM, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN_SIZE, _QKV_DIM, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN_SIZE, _QKV_DIM, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.conv1d = nn.Conv1d(
+            3 * _QKV_DIM,
+            3 * _QKV_DIM,
+            kernel_size=_CONV_KERNEL_SIZE,
+            groups=3 * _QKV_DIM,
+            padding=_CONV_KERNEL_SIZE - 1,
+            bias=False,
+            device=device,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+        )
+        self.forget_gate = _NativeForgetGate(device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.b_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN_SIZE, _NUM_HEADS, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.g_a_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN_SIZE, _LORA_RANK, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.g_b_proj = nn.Linear(_LORA_RANK, _QKV_DIM, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.o_norm = _NativeRMSNormGated(device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(_QKV_DIM, _HIDDEN_SIZE, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _l2norm(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return x / torch.sqrt(x.square().sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _recurrent_kda(
+        cls,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        gate: torch.Tensor,
+        beta: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        input_dtype = query.dtype
+        query, key, value, gate, beta = (
+            tensor.float() for tensor in (query, key, value, gate, beta)
+        )
+        query = cls._l2norm(query) * (_HEAD_DIM**-0.5)
+        key = cls._l2norm(key)
+
+        batch_size, sequence_length = query.shape[:2]
+        state = torch.zeros(
+            batch_size, _NUM_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM, _HEAD_DIM, device=query.device, dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        outputs = []
+        for token_idx in range(sequence_length):
+            query_i = query[:, token_idx]
+            key_i = key[:, token_idx]
+            value_i = value[:, token_idx]
+            decay_i = gate[:, token_idx].exp().unsqueeze(-1)
+            beta_i = beta[:, token_idx].unsqueeze(-1)
+
+            state = state * decay_i
+            value_memory = (state * key_i.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-2)
+            delta = (value_i - value_memory) * beta_i
+            state = state + key_i.unsqueeze(-1) * delta.unsqueeze(-2)
+            outputs.append((state * query_i.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-2))
+
+        return torch.stack(outputs, dim=1).to(input_dtype)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # MCore uses SBHD while the official implementation uses BSHD.
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+        batch_size, sequence_length = hidden_states.shape[:2]
+        head_shape = (batch_size, sequence_length, _NUM_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM)
+
+        # These are deliberately three independent official F.linear calls. MCore's
+        # single in_proj parameter is split explicitly when parameters are copied.
+        mixed_qkv = torch.cat(
+            [
+                F.linear(hidden_states, self.q_proj.weight),
+                F.linear(hidden_states, self.k_proj.weight),
+                F.linear(hidden_states, self.v_proj.weight),
+            ],
+            dim=-1,
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+        mixed_qkv = F.conv1d(
+            mixed_qkv.to(self.conv1d.weight.dtype),
+            self.conv1d.weight,
+            bias=None,
+            padding=_CONV_KERNEL_SIZE - 1,
+            groups=3 * _QKV_DIM,
+        )[..., :sequence_length]
+        mixed_qkv = F.silu(mixed_qkv).to(hidden_states.dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+        query, key, value = torch.split(mixed_qkv, _QKV_DIM, dim=-1)
+        query = query.view(head_shape)
+        key = key.view(head_shape)
+        value = value.view(head_shape)
+
+        forget_gate = self.forget_gate(hidden_states)
+        beta = torch.sigmoid(F.linear(hidden_states, self.b_proj.weight))
+        core_output = self._recurrent_kda(query, key, value, forget_gate, beta)
+
+        output_gate = F.linear(
+            F.linear(hidden_states, self.g_a_proj.weight), self.g_b_proj.weight
+        ).view(head_shape)
+        output = self.o_norm(core_output, output_gate).reshape(
+            batch_size, sequence_length, _QKV_DIM
+        )
+        output = F.linear(output, self.o_proj.weight)
+        return output.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+

+    dot = torch.zeros((), device=actual.device, dtype=torch.float64)
+    actual_norm = torch.zeros_like(dot)
+    expected_norm = torch.zeros_like(dot)
+
+    for start in range(0, actual_flat.numel(), _SIMILARITY_CHUNK_SIZE):
+        end = min(start + _SIMILARITY_CHUNK_SIZE, actual_flat.numel())
+        actual_chunk = actual_flat[start:end].double()
+        expected_chunk = expected_flat[start:end].double()
+        dot = dot + torch.dot(actual_chunk, expected_chunk)
+        actual_norm = actual_norm + torch.dot(actual_chunk, actual_chunk)
+        expected_norm = expected_norm + torch.dot(expected_chunk, expected_chunk)
+
+    cosine_denom = torch.sqrt(actual_norm * expected_norm)
+    tensor_denom = actual_norm + expected_norm
+    cosine = 1.0 if cosine_denom.item() == 0.0 else (dot / cosine_denom).item()
+    tensor_similarity = 1.0 if tensor_denom.item() == 0.0 else (2.0 * dot / tensor_denom).item()
+    return cosine, tensor_similarity
+
+
+def _assert_similarity(
+    actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor, *, label: str, eps: float = _SIMILARITY_EPS
+) -> None:
+    assert torch.isfinite(actual).all(), f"non-finite values in MCore {label}"
+    assert torch.isfinite(expected).all(), f"non-finite values in native {label}"
+    assert actual.numel() > 0, f"empty MCore tensor for {label}"
+    assert expected.numel() > 0, f"empty native tensor for {label}"
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(actual.detach()).item() > 0, f"all-zero MCore {label}"
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(expected.detach()).item() > 0, f"all-zero native {label}"
+    cosine, tensor_similarity = _similarity_metrics(actual, expected)
+    assert cosine > 1.0 - eps, f"{label}: cosine_sim={cosine:.6f}"
+    assert tensor_similarity > 1.0 - eps, f"{label}: tensor_sim={tensor_similarity:.6f}"
+
+
+def _assert_all_parameter_gradients(
+    real_parameters: dict[str, nn.Parameter], reference_parameters: dict[str, nn.Parameter]
+) -> None:
+    mapping = _parameter_mapping()
+    covered_real_parameters = set()
+    for reference_name, (real_name, row_slice) in mapping.items():
+        real_gradient = real_parameters[real_name].grad
+        reference_gradient = reference_parameters[reference_name].grad
+        assert real_gradient is not None, f"missing MCore gradient for {real_name}"
+        assert reference_gradient is not None, f"missing native gradient for {reference_name}"
+        _assert_similarity(
+            _mapped_tensor(real_gradient, row_slice),
+            reference_gradient,
+            label=f"parameter gradient {reference_name} <- {real_name}",
+        )
+        covered_real_parameters.add(real_name)
+
+    assert covered_real_parameters == set(real_parameters)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+def test_similarity_guard_rejects_empty_or_zero_tensors(

+    expected = torch.tensor(expected_values, dtype=torch.float32)

+def _glm53_flops_golden(args, batch_size):
+    """Independent per-query/per-module calculator, not production helpers."""
+    pattern = args.hybrid_layer_pattern.replace('|', '')
+    depths = len(pattern.split('/')) - 1
+    counts = {symbol: pattern.count(symbol) for symbol in 'KD-E'}
+    h, n, s = args.hidden_size, args.num_attention_heads, args.seq_length
+    t = batch_size * s
+    pool, budget = args.dsa_indexer_kpool, args.dsa_indexer_topk
+    tail = getattr(args, 'dsa_indexer_kpool_always_select_tail', True)
+    # Enumerate complete causal pools and each query's own incomplete tail.
+    score_pairs = batch_size * sum(j // pool for j in range(1, s + 1))
+    attention_pairs = batch_size * sum(
+        pool * min(j // pool, budget // pool) + (j % pool if tail else 0) for j in range(1, s + 1)
+    )
+    r, q, d, v, rope = (
+        args.kv_lora_rank,
+        args.q_lora_rank,
+        args.qk_head_dim,
+        args.v_head_dim,
+        args.qk_pos_emb_head_dim,
+    )
+    mla_projection = q * (h + n * (d + rope) + 1)
+    mla_projection += r * (h + n * (d + v) + 1) + h * rope + n * v * h
+    dsa = counts['D'] * (6 * t * mla_projection + 6 * n * (2 * r + rope) * attention_pairs)
+    ih, idim = args.dsa_indexer_n_heads, args.dsa_indexer_head_dim
+    indexer = (
+        counts['D']
+        * 2
+        * (t * (q * ih * idim + h * idim + h * ih + h * idim) + ih * idim * score_pairs)
+    )
+    kd, kh = args.linear_key_head_dim, args.linear_num_key_heads
+    channels = kd * kh
+    kda = (
+        counts['K']
+        * 6
+        * t
+        * (
+            h * (3 * channels + kh)
+            + 2 * h * kd
+            + 2 * kd * channels
+            + args.linear_conv_kernel_dim * 3 * channels
+            + h * channels
+            + kh * (kd * kd + 3 * kd * kd)
+        )
+    )
+    ffn = (
+        6
+        * t
+        * h
+        * 3
+        * (
+            counts['-'] * args.ffn_hidden_size
+            + counts['E']
+            * (
+                args.moe_router_topk * args.moe_ffn_hidden_size
+                + args.moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size
+            )
+        )
+    )
+    mtp = 6 * t * depths * (3 * h + 2 * h * h)
+    logits = 6 * t * h * args.padded_vocab_size * (1 + depths)
+    return dsa + indexer + kda + ffn + mtp + logits

+class _NativeRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, width, device):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(width, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        normalized = x.float() * torch.rsqrt(x.float().square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + _EPS)
+        return self.weight * normalized.to(x.dtype)

+class _NativeFrozenIndexer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, device):
+        super().__init__()
+        kwargs = dict(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16, bias=False)
+        self.wq_b = nn.Linear(_Q_RANK, _INDEX_HEADS * _INDEX_DIM, **kwargs)
+        self.wk = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN, _INDEX_DIM, **kwargs)
+        self.k_norm = nn.LayerNorm(_INDEX_DIM, eps=1e-6, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.weights_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN, _INDEX_HEADS, **kwargs)
+        self.index_kpool_compress_gate = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.randn(_INDEX_DIM, _HIDDEN, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.01
+        )
+        self.index_kpool_compress_ape = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(_POOL, _INDEX_DIM, device=device))
+        self.requires_grad_(False)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def forward(self, x, qr):
+        batch, sequence, _ = x.shape
+        query = self.wq_b(qr).view(batch, sequence, _INDEX_HEADS, _INDEX_DIM)
+        keys = self.k_norm(self.wk(x))
+        gates = F.linear(x, self.index_kpool_compress_gate)
+        count = sequence // _POOL
+        grouped_keys = keys[:, : count * _POOL].view(batch, count, _POOL, _INDEX_DIM)
+        grouped_gates = gates[:, : count * _POOL].view_as(grouped_keys)
+        probabilities = (
+            (grouped_gates.float() + self.index_kpool_compress_ape.float()[None, None])
+            .softmax(dim=2)
+            .to(keys.dtype)
+        )
+        pooled = (probabilities * grouped_keys).sum(dim=2)
+        scores = torch.matmul(query.float(), pooled.transpose(-1, -2).float().unsqueeze(1))
+        scores = F.relu(scores * (_INDEX_DIM**-0.5))
+        weights = self.weights_proj(x).float() * (_INDEX_HEADS**-0.5)
+        scores = torch.matmul(weights.unsqueeze(-2), scores).squeeze(-2)
+
+        pool_tokens = torch.arange(count * _POOL, device=x.device).view(count, _POOL)
+        valid = pool_tokens[:, -1][None, :] <= torch.arange(sequence, device=x.device)[:, None]
+        selected = (
+            scores.masked_fill(~valid[None], torch.finfo(scores.dtype).min)
+            .topk(min(_TOPK // _POOL, count), dim=-1)
+            .indices
+        )
+        selected_valid = valid[None].expand(batch, -1, -1).gather(-1, selected)
+        tokens = pool_tokens[selected].masked_fill(~selected_valid[..., None], -1).flatten(-2)
+        output = torch.full(
+            (batch, sequence, _TOPK + _POOL - 1), -1, device=x.device, dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        output[..., : tokens.size(-1)] = tokens.to(torch.int32)
+        for query_index in range(sequence):
+            tail_count = (query_index + 1) % _POOL
+            output[:, query_index, _TOPK : _TOPK + tail_count] = torch.arange(
+                query_index + 1 - tail_count, query_index + 1, device=x.device, dtype=torch.int32
+            )
+        return output

+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def forward_padded(self, x, qr, key_valid):
+        """HF selection for a ``[batch, sequence]`` padding vector.
+
+        Pools start at each sample's first valid key, a pool is a candidate only when
+        every slot is valid and its final token is visible, and the visible tail starts
+        at ``first_key + visible - visible % pool``. Padded query rows select nothing.
+        """
+        batch, sequence, _ = x.shape
+        device = x.device
+        query = self.wq_b(qr).view(batch, sequence, _INDEX_HEADS, _INDEX_DIM)
+        keys = self.k_norm(self.wk(x))
+        gates = F.linear(x, self.index_kpool_compress_gate)
+        positions = torch.arange(sequence, device=device)
+        visible = (positions[None, :] <= positions[:, None])[None] & key_valid[:, None, :]
+
+        count = (sequence + _POOL - 1) // _POOL
+        first_key = torch.where(
+            key_valid.any(-1),
+            key_valid.long().argmax(-1),
+            torch.full((batch,), sequence, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
+        )
+        pool_tokens = first_key[:, None, None] + torch.arange(count * _POOL, device=device).view(
+            1, count, _POOL
+        )
+        batch_index = torch.arange(batch, device=device)[:, None, None]
+        safe_tokens = pool_tokens.clamp(0, sequence - 1)
+        slot_valid = key_valid[batch_index, safe_tokens] & (pool_tokens < sequence)
+        pool_valid = slot_valid.all(-1)
+        pool_tokens = pool_tokens.masked_fill(~slot_valid, -1)
+        logits = gates[batch_index, safe_tokens].float()
+        logits = logits + self.index_kpool_compress_ape.float()[None, None]
+        logits = logits.masked_fill(~slot_valid[..., None], float('-inf'))
+        probabilities = torch.nan_to_num(logits.softmax(dim=2)).to(keys.dtype)
+        pooled = (probabilities * keys[batch_index, safe_tokens]).sum(dim=2)
+        scores = torch.matmul(query.float(), pooled.transpose(-1, -2).float().unsqueeze(1))
+        scores = F.relu(scores * (_INDEX_DIM**-0.5))
+        weights = self.weights_proj(x).float() * (_INDEX_HEADS**-0.5)
+        scores = torch.matmul(weights.unsqueeze(-2), scores).squeeze(-2)
+
+        pool_end = pool_tokens[..., -1].clamp(0, sequence - 1)
+        valid = visible.gather(-1, pool_end[:, None, :].expand(batch, sequence, -1))
+        valid = valid & pool_valid[:, None]
+        selected = (
+            scores.masked_fill(~valid, torch.finfo(scores.dtype).min)
+            .topk(min(_TOPK // _POOL, count), dim=-1)
+            .indices
+        )
+        selected_valid = valid.gather(-1, selected)
+        tokens = pool_tokens[batch_index, selected]
+        tokens = tokens.masked_fill(~selected_valid[..., None], -1).flatten(-2)
+        output = torch.full(
+            (batch, sequence, _TOPK + _POOL - 1), -1, device=device, dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        output[..., : tokens.size(-1)] = tokens.to(torch.int32)
+        visible_count = visible.long().sum(-1)
+        tail_count = visible_count.remainder(_POOL)
+        offsets = torch.arange(_POOL - 1, device=device)
+        tail = (first_key[:, None] + visible_count - tail_count)[..., None] + offsets
+        tail_valid = (offsets < tail_count[..., None]) & (tail < sequence)
+        tail_valid = tail_valid & visible.gather(-1, tail.clamp(0, sequence - 1))
+        output[..., _TOPK:] = tail.masked_fill(~tail_valid, -1).to(torch.int32)
+        return output.masked_fill(~key_valid[..., None], -1)
+

+class _NativeHFNoPEAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, device):
+        super().__init__()
+        kwargs = dict(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16, bias=False)
+        self.q_a_proj = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN, _Q_RANK, **kwargs)
+        self.q_a_layernorm = _NativeRMSNorm(_Q_RANK, device)
+        self.q_b_proj = nn.Linear(_Q_RANK, _HEADS * _HEAD_DIM, **kwargs)
+        self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa = nn.Linear(_HIDDEN, _KV_RANK, **kwargs)
+        self.kv_a_layernorm = _NativeRMSNorm(_KV_RANK, device)
+        self.kv_b_proj = nn.Linear(_KV_RANK, _HEADS * 2 * _HEAD_DIM, **kwargs)
+        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(_HEADS * _HEAD_DIM, _HIDDEN, **kwargs)
+        self.indexer = _NativeFrozenIndexer(device)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            for module in self.modules():
+                if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
+                    module.weight.normal_(std=0.02)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden, key_valid=None):
+        x = hidden.transpose(0, 1)
+        batch, sequence, _ = x.shape
+        qr = self.q_a_layernorm(self.q_a_proj(x))
+        query = self.q_b_proj(qr).view(batch, sequence, _HEADS, _HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
+        latent = self.kv_a_layernorm(self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa(x))
+        kv = self.kv_b_proj(latent).view(batch, sequence, _HEADS, 2 * _HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
+        keys, values = kv.split(_HEAD_DIM, dim=-1)
+        if key_valid is None:
+            selected = self.indexer(x, qr)
+        else:
+            selected = self.indexer.forward_padded(x, qr, key_valid)
+        visible = torch.zeros(batch, sequence, sequence, device=x.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        visible.scatter_add_(-1, selected.clamp_min(0).long(), (selected >= 0).to(torch.int32))
+        mask = torch.where(visible[:, None].bool(), 0.0, torch.finfo(query.dtype).min).to(
+            query.dtype

+        # Preserve HF eager attention's BF16 QK GEMM and its BF16 score boundary.
+        scores = torch.matmul(query, keys.transpose(-1, -2)) * (_HEAD_DIM**-0.5)
+        probabilities = (scores + mask).softmax(dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query.dtype)
+        output = torch.matmul(probabilities, values).transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
+        return self.o_proj(output.flatten(-2)).transpose(0, 1).contiguous(), selected

+def _hf_complete_pools(keys, gates, ape, pool_size=4):
+    """Independent HF-layout softmax, key-dtype cast, multiply, and reduction."""
+    usable = keys.shape[0] // pool_size * pool_size
+    batch, width = keys.shape[1:]
+    grouped_keys = keys[:usable].transpose(0, 1).reshape(batch, -1, pool_size, width)
+    grouped_gates = gates[:usable].transpose(0, 1).reshape(batch, -1, pool_size, width)
+    logits = grouped_gates.float() + ape.float()[None, None]
+    probabilities = torch.nan_to_num(logits.softmax(dim=2)).to(grouped_keys.dtype)
+    return (probabilities * grouped_keys).sum(dim=2).transpose(0, 1)
+

+def _hf_padded_topk_reference(q, keys, gates, ape, weights, key_valid, topk=8):
+    """Source-ordered native HF selection for a ``[batch, sequence]`` padding vector.
+
+    Transcribes Glm5NextTextIndexer.forward, get_visible_tokens, get_pooled_states and
+    append_visible_tail: pools start at each sample's first valid key, a pool is a
+    candidate only when every slot is valid and its final token is visible, and the
+    incomplete tail starts at ``first_key + visible - visible % pool``. Padded query rows
+    select nothing. Selected pools fill slots ``[0, topk)`` and the tail fills
+    ``[topk, topk + pool - 1)``, the fixed-width selector layout. Score column
+    ``first_key // pool + j`` holds the sample's pool ``j``.
+
+    No Megatron pooling, scoring, mask or selection helper is used. Shapes are
+    reduced in token/head count only; the released indexer head width remains 128.
+    """
+    sequence, batch, _, width = q.shape
+    pool_size = 4
+    device = q.device
+    positions = torch.arange(sequence, device=device)
+    visible = (positions[None, None, :] <= positions[None, :, None]) & key_valid[:, None, :]
+
+    number_of_pools = (sequence + pool_size - 1) // pool_size
+    first_key = torch.where(
+        key_valid.any(-1),
+        key_valid.long().argmax(-1),
+        torch.full((batch,), sequence, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
+    )
+    pool_offsets = torch.arange(number_of_pools * pool_size, device=device)
+    pool_indices = first_key[:, None, None] + pool_offsets.view(1, number_of_pools, pool_size)
+    batch_index = torch.arange(batch, device=device)[:, None, None]
+    safe_indices = pool_indices.clamp(0, sequence - 1)
+    grouped_keys = keys.transpose(0, 1)[batch_index, safe_indices]
+    grouped_gates = gates.transpose(0, 1)[batch_index, safe_indices]
+    grouped_valid = key_valid[batch_index, safe_indices] & (pool_indices < sequence)
+    pool_valid = grouped_valid.all(-1)
+    pool_indices = pool_indices.masked_fill(~grouped_valid, -1)
+    logits = grouped_gates.float() + ape.float()[None, None]
+    logits = logits.masked_fill(~grouped_valid[..., None], float('-inf'))
+    probabilities = torch.nan_to_num(logits.softmax(dim=2)).to(grouped_keys.dtype)
+    pool_keys = (probabilities * grouped_keys).sum(dim=2)
+
+    # Retain the source's matrix-product reduction over all indexer heads.
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.transpose(0, 1).float(), pool_keys.transpose(-1, -2).float()[:, None])
+    scores = F.relu(scores * (width**-0.5))
+    scores = torch.matmul(weights.transpose(0, 1).float().unsqueeze(-2), scores).squeeze(-2)
+
+    pool_end = pool_indices[..., -1].clamp(0, sequence - 1)
+    candidates = visible.gather(-1, pool_end[:, None, :].expand(batch, sequence, -1))
+    candidates = candidates & pool_valid[:, None]
+    select_k = min(topk // pool_size, number_of_pools)
+    selected = scores.masked_fill(~candidates, torch.finfo(torch.float32).min)
+    selected = selected.topk(select_k, dim=-1).indices
+    selected_valid = candidates.gather(-1, selected)
+    selected_tokens = pool_indices[batch_index, selected]
+    selected_tokens = selected_tokens.masked_fill(~selected_valid[..., None], -1).flatten(-2)
+
+    output = torch.full((batch, sequence, topk + 3), -1, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    output[..., : selected_tokens.size(-1)] = selected_tokens.to(torch.int32)
+    visible_count = visible.long().sum(-1)
+    tail_count = visible_count.remainder(pool_size)
+    tail_offsets = torch.arange(pool_size - 1, device=device)
+    tail = (first_key[:, None] + visible_count - tail_count)[..., None] + tail_offsets
+    tail_valid = (tail_offsets < tail_count[..., None]) & (tail < sequence)
+    tail_valid = tail_valid & visible.gather(-1, tail.clamp(0, sequence - 1))
+    output[..., topk:] = tail.masked_fill(~tail_valid, -1).to(torch.int32)
+    output = output.masked_fill(~key_valid[..., None], -1)
+
+    all_scores = torch.full((batch, sequence, sequence // pool_size), float('-inf'), device=device)
+    candidate_scores = scores.masked_fill(~candidates, float('-inf'))
+    columns = first_key[:, None] // pool_size + torch.arange(number_of_pools, device=device)
+    for sample in range(batch):
+        # Complete valid pools end in range, so their columns exist in the score tensor.
+        keep = pool_valid[sample]
+        all_scores[sample][:, columns[sample, keep]] = candidate_scores[sample][:, keep]
+    all_scores = all_scores.masked_fill(~key_valid[..., None], float('-inf'))
+    return output, all_scores
+
+
+def _hf_topk_reference(q, keys, gates, ape, weights, valid_start, valid_end, topk=8):
+    """HF reference for one contiguous valid span shared by every sample."""
+    key_valid = torch.zeros(q.size(1), keys.size(0), dtype=torch.bool, device=q.device)
+    key_valid[:, valid_start:valid_end] = True
+    return _hf_padded_topk_reference(q, keys, gates, ape, weights, key_valid, topk)
+
+
+def _padding_causal_mask(key_valid):
+    """Additive causal mask that hides padded keys and fully masks padded query rows."""
+    positions = torch.arange(key_valid.size(-1), device=key_valid.device)
+    visible = (positions[None, :] <= positions[:, None])[None]
+    visible = visible & key_valid[:, None, :] & key_valid[:, :, None]
+    mask = torch.zeros(visible.shape, device=key_valid.device)
+    return mask.masked_fill(~visible, float('-inf'))
+
+

+        use_relu=True,
+        always_select_tail=True,
+        fp8_indexer=False,
+        rotate_activation_enabled=False,
+        return_index_scores=return_index_scores,
+        kpool_key_dtype_compression=True,
+        hf_scoring=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _assert_matches_hf_reference(actual, actual_scores, expected, expected_scores):
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    if actual_scores is not None:
+        assert torch.equal(torch.isfinite(actual_scores), torch.isfinite(expected_scores))

+        torch.testing.assert_close(

+        )
+

+# Blockwise-FP8 standard placement (the GLM53 FP8 target recipe).
+GLM53_PROXY_HIDDEN, GLM53_PROXY_INTERMEDIATE = 1024, 512
+CLAMP = 10.0
+# TEGroupedMLP's Fp8Padding pads blockwise expert segments to 16 rows (TE's
+# recipe alignment, matching MCore's get_fp8_align_size for non-MXFP8 recipes).
+BLOCKWISE_FP8_ALIGN = 16
+# E4M3 keeps three mantissa bits, so round-to-nearest has unit roundoff u = 2**-4.
+# Block scales put each block's amax near the E4M3 maximum, so values within about
+# 2**14 of it are normal numbers whose rounding error is uniform within half a
+# spacing: the RMS relative error of one quantized operand is at most
+# u / sqrt(3) ~= 0.036 and at least u / (2 sqrt(3)) ~= 0.018.
+#
+# The FP32 reference evaluates FC1 on the operands the FC1 GEMM itself sees: the
+# input in 1x128 E4M3 blocks and the FC1 weight in 128x128 E4M3 blocks (TE quantizes
+# BF16 primary weights on the fly; FP8 primary weights are used as stored). An
+# independent FC1 cannot be compared at this bound. Its E4M3 noise on the std-0.5
+# gate/up rows is about sqrt(2) * 0.036 * ||x * w||_2 ~= 0.8, the clamp keeps only
+# |v| <= 10 there, and silu'' reaches 0.5 near 0. The dominant channels' SwiGLU and
+# its derivative would then differ by 10-20% relative. Everything else stays FP32 on
+# the high-precision operands (BF16 x and W, or the dequantized FP8 primary weights).
+# Each compared tensor keeps the E4M3 error of the operand uses the reference does
+# not share:
+#   output: the FC2 input, and W2 for BF16 params (at most 2)
+#   probability VJP: dY and W2 through the FC2 dgrad (at most 2)
+#   FC2 weight VJP: dY and the FC2 input, both in 128x1 blocks (2)
+#   input VJP: dY and W2, then dproj and W1 in the FC1 dgrad (at most 4)
+#   FC1 weight VJP: dY and W2 through dproj, then dproj and x in 128x1 blocks (at most 4)
+# Independent errors add in quadrature: at most sqrt(4) * 0.036 ~= 0.072 relative
+# RMS error, cosine >= 0.997. A cosine and tensor-similarity bound of 0.99 admits up
+# to sqrt(2 * 0.01) ~= 0.14: 1.9 times that worst case (3.8 times in 1 - cosine), or
+# 2.6 times at the log-uniform mean roundoff 0.027 per operand. No MCore blockwise-FP8
+# module test compares against a high-precision reference (test_early_wgrad.py
+# compares two FP8 schedules with identical quantization, rtol=0.02); TE's own
+# quantization_tols('fp8_blockwise') is the elementwise rtol=0.125 (2u) for one
+# quantized op. The 0.999 bound of the BF16/FP32 cases above (relative RMS <= 0.045)
+# is not reliable for four unshared E4M3 operand uses (up to 0.072).
+FP8_PARITY_BOUND = 0.99
+# 2**-7 separates E4M3 from BF16 arithmetic in relative RMS error. One BF16
+# round-to-nearest (unit roundoff 2**-8) has RMS relative error at most
+# 2**-8 / sqrt(3) ~= 0.0023, while every compared FP8 tensor keeps at least one
+# unshared E4M3 operand use (>= 0.018). Each FP8 tensor must exceed it, so a silent
+# BF16 forward or backward GEMM fails. The module's FC1 output must stay below it
+# against the shared-operand reference: it differs only by one BF16 output rounding
+# and accumulation order, so this checks that the reference reproduces TE's operands.
+FP8_ERROR_SPLIT = 2.0**-7
+# Clamp-set disagreements. The module's FC1 differs from the shared-operand reference
+# by its BF16 output rounding (at most one ULP near |10|, 2**-4) and by accumulation
+# order. Hopper FP8 tensor cores keep about 14 bits while accumulating each 128-deep
+# K block before FP32 promotion (DeepSeek-V3 technical report, "Increasing
+# Accumulation Precision"; block scales force that promotion per K block). With
+# unit roundoff 2**-13 per addition, the random-walk error of an n-term block sum of
+# x_k * w_k has RMS 2**-13 * sqrt((n + 1) / 6) * ||x * w||_2. A disagreement must lie
+# within eight such sigma (Gaussian tail ~1e-15 per element) plus one ULP of the
+# threshold: about 0.14 on the std-0.5 rows (||x * w||_2 ~= 16).
+CLAMP_NOISE_SIGMAS = 8.0
+BF16_ULP_AT_CLAMP = 2.0**-4
+FP8_ACCUMULATION_ROUNDOFF = 2.0**-13
+FP8_GEMM_K_BLOCK = 128
+# FC2-input placement checks. The fused SwiGLU rounds its FP32 result to BF16, then
+# rounds again after the FP32 probability product: (1 + 2**-8)**2 - 1 = 2**-7 + 2**-16,
+# plus a few FP32 roundings (2**-24); 2**-12 covers both. 2**-100 absorbs FP32 underflow
+# of silu for gates below about -87. The eager path rounds three times (silu, the
+# product, the probability product): its per-row scale is within
+# (1 + 2**-8)**3 - 1 ~= 0.0118 < 2**-6 of the probability.
+FUSED_SWIGLU_RELATIVE_ROUNDING = 2.0**-7 + 2.0**-12
+FP32_SILU_UNDERFLOW = 2.0**-100
+PLACEMENT_ROW_SCALE_TOLERANCE = 2.0**-6
+

+def _blockwise_e4m3_operand(tensor, qparams, block_scaling_dim):
+    """Dequantized GEMM operand, quantized like TE's Float8BlockScaling quantizers."""
+    import transformer_engine_torch as tex
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor.float8_blockwise_tensor import Float8BlockQuantizer
+
+    # Float8BlockScalingRecipeState.make_quantizers builds the forward quantizers from
+    # these recipe fields; rowwise data is what the forward GEMM reads.
+    quantizer = Float8BlockQuantizer(
+        fp8_dtype=tex.DType.kFloat8E4M3,
+        rowwise=True,
+        columnwise=False,
+        amax_epsilon=qparams.amax_epsilon,
+        force_pow_2_scales=qparams.power_2_scale,
+        block_scaling_dim=block_scaling_dim,
+    )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        return quantizer(tensor.detach()).dequantize(dtype=torch.float32)

+def _assert_fp8_parity(actual, expected, name):
+    """Compare in FP64 against the FP32 native reference; return the relative RMS error."""
+    assert actual is not None and expected is not None, name
+    assert actual.shape == expected.shape, name
+    a, b = actual.detach().flatten().double(), expected.detach().flatten().double()
+    assert torch.isfinite(a).all() and torch.isfinite(b).all(), name
+    aa, bb, ab = torch.dot(a, a), torch.dot(b, b), torch.dot(a, b)
+    assert aa > 0 and bb > 0, name
+    cosine = (ab / (aa * bb).sqrt()).item()
+    similarity = (2 * ab / (aa + bb)).item()
+    relative = ((a - b).norm() / bb.sqrt()).item()
+    assert cosine > FP8_PARITY_BOUND, f'{name}: cosine={cosine}, relative={relative}'
+    assert similarity > FP8_PARITY_BOUND, f'{name}: tensor_similarity={similarity}'
+    assert relative >= FP8_ERROR_SPLIT, f'{name}: no E4M3 error, relative={relative}'
+    return relative
+

+def _assert_clamp_sets_within_rounding(actual_masks, native_masks, projected, product_norm):
+    """Clamp-set disagreements must lie within FC1 rounding of the clamp threshold."""
+    gate, up = projected.chunk(2, -1)
+    sigma = FP8_ACCUMULATION_ROUNDOFF * math.sqrt((FP8_GEMM_K_BLOCK + 1) / 6.0) * product_norm
+    band = BF16_ULP_AT_CLAMP + CLAMP_NOISE_SIGMAS * sigma
+    gate_band, up_band = band.chunk(2, -1)
+    distances = ((gate - CLAMP).abs(), (up - CLAMP).abs(), (up + CLAMP).abs())
+    mismatches = []
+    for category, (distance, limit) in enumerate(zip(distances, (gate_band, up_band, up_band))):
+        mismatch = actual_masks[category] != native_masks[category]
+        far = distance[mismatch] > limit[mismatch]
+        assert not far.any(), f'clamp set {category}: {distance[mismatch][far].tolist()}'
+        mismatches.append(int(mismatch.sum()))
+    return mismatches
+

+def _blockwise_fp8_module_run(counts, *, fusion, fp8_param):
+    """Run the GLM53-proxy TEGroupedMLP forward under blockwise FP8.
+
+    Fixed seeds give identical weights and inputs on every call. Hooks capture the
+    active recipe, the padded FC1 output, and the padded FC2 input.
+    """
+    from transformer_engine.common.recipe import Float8BlockScaling, Format
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.fp8 import FP8GlobalStateManager
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor.float8_blockwise_tensor import Float8BlockwiseQTensor
+
+    counts = list(counts)
+    num_experts = len(counts)
+    config = _blockwise_fp8_config(fusion=fusion, fp8_param=fp8_param, num_experts=num_experts)
+    assert isinstance(get_fp8_recipe(config), Float8BlockScaling)
+    # Build like HybridBlock: fp8_param (fp8_param_gather) creates FP8 primary weights
+    # inside the parameter-initialization context; it is a no-op otherwise.
+    with get_fp8_context(config, is_init=True):
+        layer = get_moe_module_spec(use_te=True, num_experts=num_experts, moe_grouped_gemm=True)(
+            config=config, pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+        )
+    real = layer.cuda().experts
+    assert type(real) is TEGroupedMLP
+    assert real._with_fused_impl is False and real._use_grouped_tensor is False
+    parameters = dict(real.named_parameters())
+    assert set(parameters) == {
+        f'linear_fc{fc}.weight{expert}' for fc in (1, 2) for expert in range(num_experts)
+    }
+    for name, parameter in parameters.items():
+        assert isinstance(parameter, Float8BlockwiseQTensor) is fp8_param, name
+
+    generator = torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(20261015)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for name in sorted(parameters):
+            template = 0.02 * torch.randn(
+                parameters[name].shape, device='cuda', generator=generator
+            )
+            if name.startswith('linear_fc1.'):
+                # std 0.5 gate/up rows reach both clamp sides, as in the BF16/FP32 case.
+                for start in (0, GLM53_PROXY_INTERMEDIATE):
+                    template[start : start + 3] *= 25.0
+            # FP8 primary weights quantize the template in place (QuantizedTensor.copy_).
+            parameters[name].copy_(template.to(torch.bfloat16))
+
+    total = sum(counts)
+    hidden = torch.randn(total, GLM53_PROXY_HIDDEN, device='cuda', generator=generator)
+    hidden = hidden.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    actual_input = hidden.clone().requires_grad_()
+    probabilities = torch.linspace(0.21, 0.53, total, device='cuda', dtype=torch.float32)
+    actual_prob = probabilities.clone().requires_grad_()
+
+    entries, fc1_outputs, fc2_inputs = [], [], []
+
+    def observe_fc1_entry(_module, inputs):
+        entries.append(
+            (
+                FP8GlobalStateManager.is_fp8_enabled(),
+                FP8GlobalStateManager.get_fp8_recipe(),
+                list(inputs[1]),
+            )
+        )
+
+    def observe_fc1_output(_module, _inputs, output):
+        fc1_outputs.append(output[0].detach())
+
+    def observe_fc2_entry(_module, inputs):
+        fc2_inputs.append((inputs[0].detach(), list(inputs[1])))
+
+    hooks = [
+        real.linear_fc1.register_forward_pre_hook(observe_fc1_entry),
+        real.linear_fc1.register_forward_hook(observe_fc1_output),
+        real.linear_fc2.register_forward_pre_hook(observe_fc2_entry),
+    ]
+    try:
+        with get_fp8_context(config):
+            actual, bias = real(actual_input, torch.tensor(counts, dtype=torch.int64), actual_prob)
+    finally:
+        for hook in hooks:
+            hook.remove()
+    assert bias is None and actual.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and actual.shape == hidden.shape
+
+    # The expert GEMMs ran inside the blockwise autocast on 16-row padded segments.
+    padded = [-(-count // BLOCKWISE_FP8_ALIGN) * BLOCKWISE_FP8_ALIGN for count in counts]
+    assert len(entries) == 1 and len(fc1_outputs) == 1 and len(fc2_inputs) == 1
+    enabled, recipe, splits = entries[0]
+    assert enabled and isinstance(recipe, Float8BlockScaling)
+    assert recipe.fp8_format == Format.E4M3
+    assert splits == padded, (splits, padded)
+    fc1 = fc1_outputs[0]
+    fc2_input, fc2_splits = fc2_inputs[0]
+    assert fc1.shape == (sum(padded), 2 * GLM53_PROXY_INTERMEDIATE)
+    assert fc2_input.shape == (sum(padded), GLM53_PROXY_INTERMEDIATE)
+    assert fc2_input.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and fc2_splits == padded
+    assert torch.isfinite(fc1).all()
+    starts = [sum(padded[:expert]) for expert in range(num_experts)]
+    real_rows = torch.cat(
+        [torch.arange(start, start + count) for start, count in zip(starts, counts)]
+    ).cuda()
+    is_padding = torch.ones(sum(padded), dtype=torch.bool, device='cuda')
+    is_padding[real_rows] = False
+    # Zero padding rows are all-zero forward E4M3 blocks; they must stay exactly zero.
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(fc1[is_padding]).item() == 0
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        config=config,
+        recipe=recipe,
+        counts=counts,
+        padded=padded,
+        real_rows=real_rows,
+        is_padding=is_padding,
+        parameters=parameters,
+        hidden=hidden,
+        probabilities=probabilities,
+        actual_input=actual_input,
+        actual_prob=actual_prob,
+        actual=actual,
+        fc1=fc1,
+        fc2_input=fc2_input,
+    )
